The country and doctor both are muslim. Than is it allowed in islamic law. Question: In our case,male partner of a married pair suffering with poor quality of sperm in his seman. Due to this he is not able to pragnent her wife. Doctors advised to wishing & concentrate good sperm from his own seman and transplant at proper place & atmosphere with his wife. The country and doctor both are muslim. Than is it allowed in islamic law. Answer ID: 4835 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 935/882=D/1429) The aforesaid method is undesirable because of being unnatural, also some more things against Shariah are found to be committed as it includes shameful and sinful acts (such as masturbation, ejaculating money thorough an un-Islamic way, stripping satr of woman unnecessarily and other things) which are Islamically prohibited. Therefore, it should be avoided to opt for such method. However, if a child is born to the wife, its pedigree will be from the husband. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
